description: Red geodésica de Figueres is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Map of Figueres is a dataset that, through an interactive viewer, allows you to see the geodesic vertices, the nomenclator of the streets and orthophotos. You have the option to add and remove layers as well as to be able to manipulate, measure distances and areas, create polygons and make selections on the same map. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Geodetic network of Figueres" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Figueres, vértice geodésico, geodetic vertex, vèrtex geodèsic. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
